row.notes: Allocates a fresh 0x20-byte vector holder {alloc,begin,end,cap} plus a 0x28 shared control block and stores them at field+8/+0x10 (old block released). Then reads the top entry of the JSON reader stack (reader+0x10 ring deque): if its type word +0xe is 4 (array) it resizes the vector to the array count and, per element, pushes the element (stride 0x10) on the reader stack, calls reader vtable +0x40 (reader,0,&vec[i]) to read one 4-byte value and pops. Callers are F1OS result handlers (GetActiveScenario, GetActiveChallengeCareer, and 0x14095e250: a result-object deserializer that looks up a 15-char key then reads further fields) which push the found key's value and call this to fill an array member of the result object. (lab L1 re-check with caller context 2026-11-27)
